reason: Checking the cash drawer and who left without service is tempting, but ₹4,999 upfront plus ₹999 every month, even in slow months, is too much for something WhatsApp and my register already mostly do. My girls are used to WhatsApp, not a new English app with selfies.
objection: ₹999 a month is one more fixed cost that I pay even when the salon is quiet, and if my staff don't actually use it after the first week, the ₹4,999 is gone.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee and a monthly price around ₹499 that I can stop any time, plus seeing another salon nearby actually catch cash leakage with it.
